body: SLICE 1 MIDPOINT: all ten embed-core validating values are now final non-case classes with unchanged public reads, explicit structural equality/hash, and concise intentional renderings. The internal EmbeddingSpace provisional-copy dependency is replaced by a two-stage private constructor; RemoteCapability receipt-identity tests were rewritten as explicit package-private constructions, not copy-shape claims. Regression work now has one separately named external fromProduct refusal per type plus a positive public-read surface probe. The first focused compile is queued behind chief current full gate PID 72207; I am not overlapping sbt. Next: compile, fix any cross-platform/source issues, clean shape test, then capacity mutation.
